# fivenines_nvidia_gpus (Data Source)

The cards on this instance, and which one is throttling. Every numeric field is also a metric series, but the series is labelled by `gpu_index` and cannot tell you what that card IS -- `name` lives only on this row.

NULL IS "NVIDIA-SMI DID NOT RETURN IT", NEVER ZERO. It omits fields per driver version and per card: a consumer card reports no `power_limit`, a passthrough card in a VM reports no `fan_speed`. A 0 would read as "idle" or "drawing no power" on the one device whose job is to be busy.

`processes` has the same trap in array form: an empty list is an idle GPU, but it is also what a card in MIG mode or inside a container without PID-namespace visibility reports.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fivenines_nvidia_gpus" "all" {
  instance_id = fivenines_instance.gpu_box.id
}

# name lives only on this row: the metric series is labelled by index and
# cannot tell you which card is which.
output "gpu_inventory" {
  value = {
    for g in data.fivenines_nvidia_gpus.all.nvidia_gpus : g.index => g.name
  }
}

# Null is "nvidia-smi did not return it", never zero -- a consumer card
# reports no power_limit, a passthrough card reports no fan_speed.
output "gpus_reporting_power_limits" {
  value = [
    for g in data.fivenines_nvidia_gpus.all.nvidia_gpus :
    g.index if g.power_limit != null
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) The instance (host) UUID the rows belong to.

### Optional

- `q` (String) Case-insensitive substring match on the card name.
- `stale` (Boolean) Freshness filter over the collector's 10-minute sync window. `false` returns only rows the agent refreshed inside it -- the set you may read as CURRENT state; `true` returns the rest. The two values partition the collection (a row that never synced counts as stale). Omit for both.
- `updated_since` (String) Return only rows whose `updated_at` is at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp. Inclusive, so a row updated in the same instant as the cursor comes back rather than falling through the gap. The ingester touches `updated_at` on every agent tick, so this is a freshness filter rather than a change feed, and there are no tombstones: a row the agent stops reporting is deleted.

### Read-Only

- `collector` (Attributes) Why the row list looks the way it does. Read this before treating an empty list as a clean bill of health: `[]` alone cannot distinguish "this host genuinely runs none" from "the collector is switched off" (which deletes the rows) or "this agent is too old to report them". (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--collector))
- `nvidia_gpus` (Attributes List) The rows the collector reported. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nvidia_gpus))

<a id="nestedatt--collector"></a>
### Nested Schema for `collector`

Read-Only:

- `blocked_reason` (String) The agent's own explanation, where it sent one. Null otherwise.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the operator has this collector switched on for the instance. Switching it off deletes the rows, so `false` fully explains an empty list.
- `last_reported_at` (String) The instance's last agent check-in -- not this collector's. It separates "this collector went quiet" (rows stale, instance reporting) from "the whole agent went quiet" (both). Per-row freshness is each row's `last_synced_at`.
- `name` (String) The collector these rows come from.
- `pending` (Boolean) Enabled, and the agent knows the feature, but the capability is not satisfied yet (missing binary, missing permission). The rows are legitimately absent and may appear on a later tick.
- `supported` (Boolean) Whether this agent can collect these rows -- its own capability verdict where it reports one, its version otherwise. `false` alongside `enabled` means the instance was asked for something it cannot deliver. Read it as "the agent has not said it cannot": the config-driven collectors (haproxy, rabbitmq, php_fpm, wireguard) have no version floor, so an agent predating one still reports `true` with an empty list.
- `unavailable_reason` (String) Why `supported` is false: `host_lacks_feature` (the agent probed and reported it cannot) or `agent_outdated` (the agent predates the release that collects these rows). Null when supported.


<a id="nestedatt--nvidia_gpus"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nvidia_gpus`

Read-Only:

- `clock_mem` (Number) MHz.
- `clock_sm` (Number) MHz.
- `created_at` (String) When this row was first recorded. This is when the agent first happened to report it, not anything an operator would recognize.
- `fan_speed` (Number) Percent. Null on any card with no controllable fan -- a passthrough card in a VM, or a passively cooled datacentre part. Not 0.
- `host_id` (String) The instance (host) UUID this row belongs to.
- `id` (Number) Row identifier.
- `index` (Number) The nvidia-smi enumeration index, and half the row's identity (the upsert key is host + index). NOT stable across a reboot if cards are added or removed.
- `last_synced_at` (String) Server arrival time of the tick that last refreshed this row (never the agent's clock). Null when the row has never synced.
- `memory_free` (Number) Free framebuffer memory, in bytes. Null when not reported.
- `memory_total` (Number) Total framebuffer memory, in bytes. Null when not reported.
- `memory_used` (Number) Bytes.
- `name` (String) The card model as nvidia-smi reports it. Null when not reported.
- `power_draw` (Number) Watts. Null = not reported, not "drawing no power".
- `power_limit` (Number) Watts. Null on consumer cards that do not expose one.
- `processes` (String) The compute processes nvidia-smi attributed to this card. An EMPTY ARRAY IS AMBIGUOUS: it is an idle GPU, but it is also what a card in MIG mode or inside a container without PID-namespace visibility reports. Do not read it as "nothing is using this GPU". JSON-encoded; decode with `jsondecode()`.
- `stale` (Boolean) The row has not been refreshed inside the collector's 10-minute window (a NULL `last_synced_at` counts as stale). `false` means safe to read as current state.
- `temperature` (Number) Degrees Celsius. Null = not reported, not 0.
- `updated_at` (String) When this row was last written. The ingester touches it on every agent tick, so it is a freshness stamp rather than a change feed.
- `utilization_gpu` (Number) Percent. Null = not reported, which is NOT an idle GPU.
- `utilization_memory` (Number) Percent of memory BANDWIDTH in use -- not memory occupancy.
